title: Add a failing test that a security-reviewer verdict is stored with the role `security-reviewer` and posted once, and that a handoff with no verdict writes nothing and posts nothing. Then implement that store. Verify the test fails with `node --test test/review-comment.test.mjs` before the edit, and passes with the same command after it.
acceptanceCriteria: A stored security-reviewer verdict is posted and a missing one is not invented.
